name: The Night Watch
description: A civic militia company marches out under Captain Frans Banninck Cocq -- famous for its dramatic use of light and shadow.

name: The Anatomy Lesson of Dr. Nicolaes Tulp
description: Amsterdam surgeons gather round a cadaver for a public dissection -- one of Rembrandt's earliest group portraits.

name: Christ in the Storm on the Sea of Galilee
description: Rembrandt's only seascape -- the disciples struggle against a sudden squall on the Sea of Galilee.

name: Self-Portrait
description: One of dozens of self-portraits Rembrandt painted across his life -- this one from a difficult financial period.

name: The Jewish Bride
description: A tender double portrait of a couple, likely biblical figures -- praised for its rich, glowing brushwork.

name: Impression, Sunrise
description: A hazy sunrise over Le Havre harbour -- the painting that gave Impressionism its name.

name: Woman with a Parasol -- Madame Monet and Her Son
description: Monet's wife Camille and son Jean, seen from below against a breezy summer sky.

name: Water Lilies
description: One of roughly 250 water lily paintings Monet made in his garden at Giverny in his later years.

name: Wheatstacks (End of Summer)
description: Part of a series painted at different times of day and year to study how light changes a single subject.

name: Rouen Cathedral, West Facade, Sunlight
description: One of over thirty views of the cathedral's facade Monet painted from a shop window across the square.

name: The Starry Night
description: A swirling night sky over a quiet village -- painted from memory at an asylum in Saint-Remy.

name: Sunflowers
description: One of several sunflower still lifes Van Gogh painted to decorate the house he shared with Paul Gauguin in Arles.

name: Cafe Terrace at Night
description: A lamp-lit cafe terrace in Arles under a starry sky -- notable for using no black paint at all.

name: Bedroom in Arles
description: Van Gogh's own bedroom in the Yellow House -- he painted three versions of this same room.

name: Self-Portrait
description: One of around 35 self-portraits Van Gogh painted over his career, often used to practice technique.

name: The Great Wave off Kanagawa
description: A towering wave threatens boats off the coast, with Mount Fuji small in the distance -- probably the most reproduced Japanese artwork ever made.

name: Fine Wind, Clear Morning (Red Fuji)
description: Mount Fuji glows red in early morning light -- part of the same Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji series as the Great Wave.

name: Thunderstorm Beneath the Summit
description: Lightning strikes the base of Mount Fuji while its snow-capped peak stays clear above the clouds.

name: Kajikazawa in Kai Province
description: A fisherman balances on rocks with a line, Mount Fuji framed between the cliffs behind him.

name: Ejiri in Suruga Province
description: A sudden gust of wind scatters papers and hats as travellers cross a windswept plain near Mount Fuji.
